name: ibaad-toolkit
description: Generic agent toolkits for video production, website development, app development, engineering and 3D printing, and digital marketing.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Shared building blocks: report format, brief contract, AI image prompting, Firefly driver, ffmpeg recipes, delivery, browser hygiene, llm-council, client-config loader, platform adapters (action to tool name per agent).

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Firefly and Veo generation, Blender product renders, Kdenlive and ffmpeg editing, studio folder system.

plugins.name: website-development
plugins.description: Site cloning, taste-level UI/UX, Wix headless and Shopify builds, SEO and AI-search readiness.

plugins.name: app-development
plugins.description: Competitor feature extraction, mobile UI rules, building apps with Claude Code, store release.

plugins.name: engineering-3d-printing
plugins.description: Functional-first design, CAD, design for printing, Bambu Lab print workflow, ESP32 firmware.

plugins.name: digital-marketing
plugins.description: Competitor and ad-library research, low-budget strategy, Meta and Google ads operations, static and video ad production, newsletters.

plugins.name: replica-skill
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). The app reverse-engineering pack. replica-recon maps any app into screens, flows, a data model and a feature matrix; ten more skills cover architecture, design, build, backend, test, parity diff, brand, launch and deploy.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Anti-slop art direction for landing pages: researched directions, real pictures, a browser inspector and a critique loop.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Searchable UI/UX data: styles, palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines, chart types. Overlaps with taste-skill; useful for its palette and font data.

plugins.name: wix
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Official Wix skills (headless, CLI apps, design system, site management) plus the Wix MCP server (OAuth, no key).

plugins.name: brightdata-plugin
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Web data for any toolkit: scrape pages, search, structured data from big platforms, competitor intel, brand listening, SEO audits. Its CLI and MCP need a Bright Data API key.

plugins.name: runway-api
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Runway video and image generation. Only worth it with a paid Runway account; calls need RUNWAYML_API_SECRET.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Third-party (Apache-2.0). Deterministic design anti-pattern detector with a hook on UI edits. Run /impeccable init once per project.

plugins.name: shopify-plugin
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Official Shopify AI Toolkit: Liquid themes, Admin and Storefront APIs, app development.

plugins.name: android-reverse-engineering
plugins.description: Third-party (Apache-2.0). APK decompile with jadx: endpoints, features, libraries. Pairs with replica-skill for Android apps. Needs JDK 17+ and jadx.

plugins.name: expo
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Official Expo skills: router, native UI, EAS builds and store submission.

plugins.name: android-skills
plugins.description: Third-party (Apache-2.0). Official Google Android skills.

plugins.name: aso-skills
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). App Store Optimisation: keywords, screenshots, listing tests, rejection recovery.

plugins.name: flutter-all
plugins.description: Third-party (no licence file). Flutter agents and patterns. Thin; expect to maintain your own notes on top.

plugins.name: text-to-cad
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). CAD from text, STEP/STL/3MF, printability check, OrcaSlicer G-code, send to Bambu printers. Turn telemetry off: uvx cadgen telemetry off.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Brainstorming, planning, systematic debugging.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT (stated in README; no licence file)). Think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes: the anti-over-engineering layer.

plugins.name: marketing-skills
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). About 50 skills: copywriting, CRO, launch, emails, competitor profiling, pricing.
